question: State Health Index is an initiative of NITI Aayog, in collaboration with Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and with technical assistance from the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Institute for Competitiveness**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **State Health Index** is an initiative of **NITI Aayog**, developed in collaboration with the **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare**, and with technical assistance from the **Institute for Competitiveness**.
 
• The **State Health Index** aims to measure and monitor the performance of states and union territories in the **health sector**, focusing on outcomes, governance, and processes.
 
• The **Institute for Competitiveness** is India’s foremost think tank that works on competitiveness and strategy. It provides **technical expertise** to enhance the framework and methodology of indices like the State Health Index.
 
• The index is released annually and evaluates states based on various parameters such as **neonatal mortality rate, maternal mortality rate, immunization coverage**, and overall healthcare infrastructure.
 
• The collaboration ensures that the index is robust and provides actionable insights for states to improve their **healthcare systems**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Institute for Competitiveness:**

 
 
• The **Institute for Competitiveness** is a global partner of the **Institute for Strategy and Competitiveness** at Harvard Business School and is part of the **Microeconomics of Competitiveness network.**
 
• It provides **policy-related insights** and focuses on improving productivity and economic performance in India.
 
• It also contributes to initiatives like the **India Innovation Index**, **Ease of Living Index**, and other strategic frameworks.
 
 
 
• **State Health Index:**
 
 
• The State Health Index is a tool to drive **healthy competition** among states and union territories to improve their healthcare systems.
 
• It has three main domains: **Health Outcomes, Governance and Information, and Key Inputs/Processes**.
 
• States are categorized as **Larger States, Smaller States, and Union Territories** for a fair comparison.
 
• The index helps policymakers identify areas requiring attention and measure the **impact of health interventions**.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare:**
 
 
• The Ministry plays a critical role in formulating and implementing health-related policies in India.
 
• It also supports initiatives like the **National Health Mission (NHM)**, **Ayushman Bharat**, and other healthcare programs.
 
• The ministry ensures that indices like the State Health Index align with national priorities and international health standards.
 
 
 
• **NITI Aayog:**
 
 
• **NITI Aayog**, established in **2015**, is the premier policy think tank of the Government of India.
 
• It focuses on fostering **cooperative federalism** through structured support initiatives like indices and rankings.
 
• It ensures that initiatives like the **State Health Index** promote sustainable and inclusive development in line with India’s vision for **healthcare reform**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Technical Assistance Organizations:**

 
 
• The **World Bank** is often involved in large-scale healthcare reforms globally and provides financial and technical support for various health programs.
 
• The **CSIR** (Council of Scientific and Industrial Research) contributes to innovation and research in healthcare but does not directly assist in the State Health Index.
 
• The **Ministry of Earth Sciences** focuses on environmental and climate-related aspects, not healthcare indices.
 
 
 
• **Impact of State Health Index:**
 
 
• The index encourages states to focus on outcomes and transparency in governance.
 
• It has resulted in some states implementing targeted interventions to improve maternal and child health indicators.
 
• It is considered a foundational tool for achieving **UN Sustainable Development Goals** related to health in India.
